revocation_reason: The exact app flashed and reached the first downstream retry, but the retry raced an external-hub control transfer. The hub rejected the new request with ESP_ERR_INVALID_STATE and usbh_dev_close asserted because one control transfer remained in flight. This repeated on every boot, so the candidate is revoked and must be replaced with a no-retry recovery image before further experimentation.
operator_direction: Install the verified 0.4.20 controller-first successor on the bound Waveshare 4.3 so an actual failed external-hub child enumeration gets at most two downstream-port resets after the failed USBH node is freed. Reuse the existing factory backup; write only the primary application and do not touch the microSD.

fixture.h2: operator-attested externally powered USB-C hub with power input
fixture.scope: experimental externally powered H2 data-path acceptance only

ota_data.live_policy: mutable boot-selection state; preserve without writing

recovery_contract: exclude esp_hosted, esp_wifi_remote, platform_signal_scan, and their constructor-driven SDIO transport from the linked component graph
mount the application VFS directly during normal boot without allocating a TinyUSB MSC storage object
allocate and destroy the MSC object only inside the explicit mutually exclusive USB Drive transition
retry bounded Waveshare boot-frame submissions and preserve the last visible frame and backlight on a transient refresh timeout
keep the pinned espressif/usb 1.5.0 managed package byte-for-byte unchanged and compile one deterministic generated ext_port.c overlay only in the controller-first profile
retain the vendor downstream-port reset-attempt default of one and use a 500 ms reset-recovery interval
classify only an actual enumeration cancellation that disables a still-connected unenumerated external-hub child
wait until the failed USBH node is freed before resetting only that downstream port and permit at most two retries
reset the enumeration retry budget only on physical reconnect and leave ordinary hot-plug ready after bounded exhaustion
never infer controller failure merely because no HID device is attached
runtime_contract: boot H2 in externally powered controller-host mode without firmware VBUS sourcing
force the high-speed-capable H2 root to the supported full-speed-only policy before root-port enable
support bounded HID gamepad, boot keyboard, and boot mouse hot-plug through one powered hub level
neutralize all input before Host/HID teardown and on disconnect
show a dedicated USB Drive launcher app
quiesce and uninstall Host/HID before unmounting the app VFS and installing TinyUSB device MSC
require clean host eject or disconnect before uninstalling MSC, deleting its on-demand object, remounting microSD, rescanning games, and restarting Host/HID
roll back to the app VFS when possible and leave H2 quiesced on any failed transition; never run both roles together
preserve the 768x480 BBS shell, official gamechangersai.org logo, boot audio, touch, dynamic SD games, and existing microSD contents

acceptance_required_after_install: retained H1 UART reaches app_main and Console OS READY with no panic, watchdog, boot loop, brownout, eager MSC allocation failure, or fatal display halt
UART reports the 32 KiB internal/DMA reserve, direct application SD mount, lazy MSC policy, controller-first H2, full-speed root policy, USB Host/HID ready, and the dynamic catalog
the powered hub enumerates without an unsupported high-speed transaction-translator rejection
after an initial descriptor failure, UART reports no more than two P4_EXT_PORT_ENUM_RETRY attempts and does not tear down the complete Host/HID graph
P4_EXT_PORT_ENUM_RECOVERED appears before exhaustion and the attached low-speed HID child reaches the class driver
the applicable gamepad, keyboard, or mouse connection counter becomes nonzero
hot-unplug immediately neutralizes the connected device and a later replug enumerates without reboot
USB Drive stops Host/HID, allocates MSC on demand, enumerates microSD on macOS, blocks unsafe return, then clean eject deletes MSC, returns to Host/HID, and rescans games
